ResourceHeader.Description: The Magnetospheric Multiscale (MMS) mission is a Solar Terrestrial Probes Program mission within NASA's Heliophysics Division. The MMS mission, consisting of four identically instrumented spacecraft, will use Earth's magnetosphere as a laboratory to study magnetic reconnection.
